method: Unblinded per-output review. Complete means expected behavior plus retention of the required facts, qualification/force, dates and attribution in the drafted synthesis. Exact evidence quotes do not repair missing or weakened drafted content. Contradictions use explanation plus evidence because no replacement is drafted. Missing provider output is unavailable, not a semantic failure. These labels are descriptive judgments, not a statistically validated ranking.
